scene: The clanking cabin sways gently as gears hum beneath the floor.
beats: Inside rests a tame clockwork cricket that chirps your arrival just as the crawler docks smoothly at Gear Bridge, and you disembark.
She trades you a souvenir gear token for a comet rumor, then pulls the whistle as the crawler clanks onto Gear Bridge.
The pipe sighs sweet cinnamon steam across the cabin, and the crawler slides into the bustling docks of Gear Bridge as you step out.
picture: Side view inside the crawler cabin. On the far left sits a passenger bench under a luggage rack holding a shaking wicker basket. The player stands centre with telescope slung. To the right, an apron-clad conductor polishes a brass horn beside a wall mounted with a shiny steam pipe and brass dial.
shown: a vibrating wicker trunk tied with purple string up high on the left rack
a conductor in an apron polishing a brass horn, seated on the right
a polished brass wheel on a rattling steam pipe on the far right
